resolution: Fixed the prefabs-tab crash plus the two follow-ups in the same breath. (1) Crash: GAME_BUILD.prefabs.definitions is a Record, not an array — .map threw and the CatalogRail crashed the whole pane; Object.values() it (424e5d2a7). (2) Materials 'went away': the iso pane never mounted the build-skin TextureCapture, so a piece skinned with a material rendered flat because nothing bound its bldskin:<id> texture — now mounts one TextureCapture per referenced skin id (skinTextureIds mirrors F2's skinTextureIdsFromSet), same as F2 (1697b4e44). (3) Prefabs list: only the 1 built-in (Motel Room) showed because F2's 3 = built-ins MERGED with user-captured stream prefabs; IsoAuthor now takes the full buildingPrefabs list the cart already computes and resolves prefab defs from it for the ghost/stamp/label (a stream prefab isn't in GAME_BUILD.prefabs). index.tsx passes prefabs={buildingPrefabs} — live in the working tree, held out of the commit because another session has uncommitted work in index.tsx. Bundles clean (esbuild exit 0).
